{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in the two variables of interest
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute the overall Pearson correlation
overall_corr = filtered_df['flipper_length_mm'].corr(filtered_df['body_mass_g'])

# Print the number of rows after dropping missing values
print(len(filtered_df))

# Print the correlation coefficient
print(overall_corr)"}
